sentences.en: The diversity of flowers in this meadow is absolutely unbelievable.
sentences.zh: 这个草地上的花种类繁多，简直让人难以置信。

sentences.en: Horses don't like buttercups; they just leave them in the meadow.
sentences.zh: 马不喜欢蒲公英；它们只是把蒲公英留在草地上不管。

sentences.en: People with no humour are like meadows without flowers.
sentences.zh: 没有幽默感的人就像一片没有花朵的草地。
